title: Pocketwire Personal Account Terms: One Account per Person
content:
**Clause.** Each person may hold one Pocketwire Personal Account, identified by the customer profile. A new personal account may be opened only if the customer holds no other personal account whose status is anything other than closed. A customer whose earlier personal account was closed may open a new one; a customer who wants a second balance for business activity opens a Pocketwire Business Profile instead, which is a separate product and never counts against this limit.

The limit is 1 personal account per customer profile.

**Basis of the check.** The check rests on the system record of the personal accounts held under the same customer profile and their status on the date of the new sign-up, not on the customer's own description of them.

**Existing personal account under the same profile, and the effect on a new sign-up**

| Status of the existing personal account | Does this limit stand in the way of a new personal account? |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Limited | Yes |
| Locked | Yes |
| Closure pending | Yes |
| Closed | No |
| No personal account at all | No |

**Points of judgement**

- A Pocketwire Business Profile held by the customer is a separate product and is not counted as a personal account under this clause, whatever its status.
- A personal account in closure pending status still counts: only a closed account leaves the customer free under this clause to open a new one.
